subject.title: Feature: durable natural-language rule learning + explicit multi-mention reply semantics

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class durable conversational rule-governance layer and cross-channel explicit multi-bot mention semantics, or keep this issue split into memory-plugin and channel-plugin follow-ups?
rationale: The requested behavior crosses memory authority, storage shape, workspace-file precedence, conflict supersession, and channel reply policy, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Keep As Design Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-sponsored design that defines rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, promotion review, and channel mention semantics before implementation.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Trackers
options.body: Track Feishu self-mention and app-scoped identity bugs separately, and open a smaller memory-governance design only if maintainers want durable conversational rules.

options.title: Route To Plugin/API Design
options.body: Require the durable rule-learning capability to prove it cannot be built through memory/plugin APIs before adding new core rule-layer surface.

recommendation.title: Keep As Design Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-sponsored design that defines rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, promotion review, and channel mention semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-history signal across the inspected memory prompt, memory promotion, Feishu parser, and linked Feishu identity review paths.
